sentences.text:
The Court made the following:
Order:
The instant petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (in short, "Cr.P.C.")
has been filed by the Petitioners/ Accused Nos.1 to 4, seeking quashment of the proceedings against

them in Crime No.79 of 2022 of Inavilli Police Station, East Godavari District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 417, 420, 493, 376, 384, 313 & 506 read with section 109 of the Indian Penal Code, VJP,J 1860, Sections 76 & 78 of the Information Technology Act, Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C.
2.

sentences.text: Despite the matter is listed under the caption 'for dismissal', none represented for the Petitioners.
3. The docket proceedings dated 04.09.2024 and 11.09.2024 show, no representation on behalf of the Petitioners.
4. Ms. K.Priyanka Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor representing the State/Respondent No.1 is in attendance.
